_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Shell exit closes only its own tab, keeping command output. The test seeded a conversation at /c/term-exit. "The terminal input" is the visible terminal's input, '.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"] textarea[aria-label="Terminal input"]' (other terminals' inputs are hidden); to type into it, focus it with an eval (.focus()), then use type steps, which type key by key, and press_key for Enter or Control+d. To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). 
1. Navigate to /c/term-exit. Send "!printf preserved-output" (fill [data-testid="message-input"] with it and click [data-testid="send-button"]). There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-success".
2. Send "!". There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-running".
3. Type "exit 0" into the terminal input and press Enter.
4. There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab", and ".terminal-panel-tab-active" should have the title attribute exactly "printf preserved-output".
5. Choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input". The message input's value should contain "preserved-output".
